﻿﻿This mod adds 50 pieces of furniture for you to build your very own farmer's market.
This add-on to Farmer's Market core adds a fishmonger and butcher set for all your market needs. 

[b][size=4]Recolors available via config! Choose from Classic, Light or Dark

This mod is for SDV 1.6 - does not work with older versions of the game

Available in English, Chinese (thanks to [b][size=4]Lala92876[/size][/b]) and French (thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Mazoout/mods]Mazout[/url])
